full_judgment:
Mr. Sharif Uddin Chaklader, J:- This rule was issued by a Division Bench of this Court on 17.03.2008 in the following terms:-. 

 "Let a rule issue calling upon opposite party Nos. 1-10 to show cause as to why  their personal properties shall not be attached for payment of compensation of damages caused to the petitioner by demolishing, their houses in the 'Kha(2)' schedule property and as to why they  shall not be detained in civil prison for a period of six months for willful violation/disobedience of the order of injunction passed by this Court on 03.03.2008 in Civil Rule No. 132 (FM) of 2008 and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper." 

 3. The suit was decreed by the High Court Division in Appeal from Original Decree No. 128 of 2012. 

 The entire 23.13 acre 'Ka' schedule suit land of Title Suit No. 23 of 2008 appertaining to C.S. khatian No. 07 of Mouza Chandona being projabili property under the previous Bhawal Jaminder. Kumar Rabindra Narayan Roy Chowdhury and others represented by court of words. the then government for the purpose of acquisition of rent receiving interest of the said jaminder, at first, published projabili property gazette notification under section 3 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, shortly SAT-Act, 1950 on 24.03.1952 (Exhibit 7), describing therein the schedules of projabili properties and thereafter, the government after paying compensation to the said jaminder for acquisition of rent receiving interest of their projabili property cited in the said projabili gazette, published compensation payment gazetee on 29.02.1956 (Exhibit-9) declaring compensation had been paid to the jaminders as per compensation, when the Government prepared and published S.A. khatian No. 63 (Exhibit-1) connecting with the suit property was duly prepared and published in the names of the previous joint projas, Chan Miah and Basaruddin in equal /8/ (eight) annas share; after scrutinizing the concerned projabili property papers and documents connected with the suit property remained in the sherestha/ custody of the jaminder and thereafter, the Revenue Department of the Government, like title register of the then jaminder, Kumar Rabindra Narayan Roy Chowdhury represented by Court of Wards (Exhibit-4), projabili property gazette (Exhibit-9) etc. upgrading their status from projas to owners. The government not only prepared and published S.A. khatian No. 63 (Exhibit-1) in the names of the previous projas, Chan Miah and Basaruddin as equal /8/ (eight) annas owners upgrading their status as owners but also inserted their names in the Register-II, Talab Baki Register (Exhibit-5), as rent payees in equal shares to the Government Revenue Department. Further case of them is that, on amicable partition Basaruddin got in total 5.40 acre 'Kha' schedule 6 piece properties in his /8/ (eight) annas share. wherein he and thereafter on his demised, the present plaintiffs appellants petitioners as his heirs have been owning, and possessing by erecting and constructing homestead in the 'Kha (2 )' schedule suit property and by opening holding No. 220, Laxmipura, under Gazipur Municipality against it and by paying taxes and deferent bills like electricity, Titas Gas etc. taken against the said holding No. 220 (exhibit-13 series) and the rest 'Kha( I)', 'Kha(3)', 'Kha(4)', 'Kha (5)', and 'Kha (6)', schedules as agricultural lands and ponds by way of cultivating and by rearing fish; inspite of acquisition of ownership and possession as stated herein above by operation of SAT Act. 1950 in the 'Kha' schedule 6 piece properties, the opposite party No. 1, Mr. Abdur Rouf claining himself as manager of Court of Wards, the defendant. No. 14 of Title Suit No. 23 of 2008 and also claiming as shebayet of Sree Sree Madhab Bigraha, defendant No. 1 of said title suit No. 23 of 2008, opposite party No.2 and 3 of the present petition, came to `Kha' schedule suit properties on 12.12.2007 and expressed to the petitioners that family deity Madhab Bigraha, the defendant No.. 1 through his representation as shebayet, got a decree of declaration of title and recovery of khan possession of total 18.73 acres land out of 'Ka' scheduled 23.13 acres land including the petitioner's 'Kha' scheduled 6 piece 5.40 acres properties in Title Suit No. 1219 of 1985 of the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge, Gazipur against some third parties, Chan Miah and others and asked the petitioners to handover possession of the said 'Kha' scheduled 6 pieces properties in favour of decree holder, Sree Sree Madhab Bigraha, through him as shebayet; that the petitioners after knowing about the aforesaid decree passed in Title Suit No. 1219 of 1985, filed Title Suit No. 23 of 2008 challenging the said decree as fraudulent, collusive and not binding upon them along with other consequential reliefs of confirmation of possession and permanent injunction on 06.01.2008. 

 5. In the said suit the petitioners as plaintiffs filed an application under Order XXXIX Rule 1 and 2 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for ad-interim and temporary injunction on the next day on 07.01.2008 praying for restraining defendant No. 1, Madhab Bigraha and defendant No. 14, Court of Words, Bhawal Raj Estate stating the self same facts of acquisition of title and possession by operation SAT Act. 1950, as stated in the plaint. 

 6. Trial court, after hearing both the parties was pleased to reject the said petition for temporary injunction on 24.02.2008 on contest with the said defendant No. 1, deity and defendant No.14, Court of Words. Plaintiff — petitioners as appellants being aggrieved, filed Appeal from Original Order No. 117 (FM) of 2008 on 28.02.2008 and informed about filing of said appeal and also fixing the date of admission hearing on 03.03.2008 to opposite party No. 1., Mr. Abdur Raouf verbally; that opposite party No. 1, Abdur Rouf, after knowing of filing of said appeal and of being sanguine about in exeutivility of the decree passed in Title Suit No. 1219 of 1985 against the third parties, strangers, the present plaintiffs-petitioners, he influenced the opposite party No. 6, Mr. Syed Mizanur Rahman, the then Deputy Commissioner, Gazipur for taking over possession of 'Kha' schedule 6 piece properties by starting eviction case under the government Properties Recovery Act. 1970 without executing the decree passed in Title Suit No. 1219 of 1985; opposite party No. 6, Syed Mizanur Rahman the then. Deputy Commissioner, Gazipur on being such influence by the opposite party No.1, Abdur Rouf, sent Mr. Md. Shahjalal, an executive Magistrate on 28.02.2008 for evicting the petitioners from their 'Kha' schedule properties by taking law in their own hands bitt could not successful due to protest raised by the petitioners and also for non co-operation of Gazipur Police as their own property covering Gazipur Police Line was included in the said fraudulent decree of Title Suit No. 1219 of 1985. The said happenings was published on the next day in different local newspapers of Gazipur namely, 'Dainik Gonomukh' and 'Mukta Sangbad' (Annexures-A (1) and A(2); that petitioners for protecting their 'Kha' schedule suit properties lodged a G.D. entry No. 142 on 02.03.2008 (Annexure-A) in the Office of concerned Joydebpur Police Station addressing to the then Officer-in-Charge, Mr. Mizanur Rahman, the opposite party No. 9 requesting him not to help the deity, the defendant No. 1 and court of Wards the defendant No. 14 and their officers in evicting the petitioners from their 'Kha' schedule 6 piece properties: in the mean time on 03.03.2008 the FMAT No. I17 (FM) of 2008 was heard for admission by a Division Bench of this Court, comprising of their lordships, Mr. Justice Abdul Wahhab Miah and Mr. Justice Afzal Hossain Ahmed who after hearing was pleased to admit the appeal as FMA No. 124 of 2008 and also heard the petition for temporary injunction filed by the petitioners and was pleased to issue rule and passed an order of injunction in Civil Rule No. 132 (FM) of 2008 (Annexure-B) on 03.03.2008 at 11.30 a.m. as follows: 

 "Let a rule be issued calling upon opposite party Nos. 1 to 14 to show cause as to why they shall not he restrained by an order of injunction from evicting the plaintiffs-petitioners from the 'Kha' schedule property in the suit as described in the schedule property in the schedule of the application either by executing the decree dated 24.10.1994 passed in Title Suit No. 1219 of 1985 of the court of the then Sub-ordinate Judge, 1st Court, Gazipur or in any other manner till disposal of F.M.A. No. 124 of 2008 and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 7. Petitioners Advocate Mr. Md. Khalilur Rahman after obtaining the aforesaid order of injunction issued lawyer's certificate and sent the same to his junior Advocate Mrs, Taslima Momin Lima practicing at Gazipur District Court to Fax No.9252751 who after receiving the same at 1.30 P.M. on 03.03.2008, rushed to the 'Kha' schedule suit property then and there with lawyer certificate before arriving the police force sent by opposite party. No. 7, Mr. Alamgir Alam, S.P. Gazipur at the illegal influence of the opposite party No. 1, Abdur Rouf; police contingent headed by opposite party No. 9, Mr. Md. Mizanur Rahman. the then O.C. of Joydebpur Police Station, Mr. Md. Shahjalal, Assistant Commissioner, Executive Magistrate, opposite party No. 8, arrived in 'Kha' schedule suit property at about 2.00 P.M. on 03.03.2008 and found Mrs. Taslima Momin Lima, Advocate present there. Inspite of showing lawyer's certificate about issuing order of injunction by the Hon'ble High Court Division on 03.03.2008 at 11.30 A.M. and requesting them not to evict from and demolish the house of 'Kha' (2) Schedule suit properties showing respect to the High Court's order of injunction. But both of them uttering bad words about order of injunction passed by the Hon'ble High Court Division started to demolish the structures of 'Kha'(2) schedule suit property at 2.25 P.M.' in front of said Advocate Mrs. Lima and thousands of people arrived from nearby area creating a humanitarian problem in `Kha' (2) schedule suit property wherein about 40 families as monthly tenants under the plaintiffs petitioners and the plaintiffs themselves were living with their respective families; the opposite parties after demolishing maximum pucca, semi pucca and tin ghars of 'Kha'(2) schedule suit property left at 5.30 P.M. leaving only two semi-pucca ghars wherein the female members and children took shelters for their survival; that the plaintiffs petitioners on coming to know on 04.03.2008 that the opposite party No. 4, Md. Sabbir Hossain, an Assistant Manager of Court of 'Words, was again coming to the 'Kha'(2) schedule suit properties on 05.03.2008 with the police force headed by opposite party No. 9. Mr. Md, Mizanur Rahman, Officer-in Charge of Joydebpur Police Station and also with the help of opposite party No.8, Mr. Md. Shahjalal. executive Magistrate, Gazipur for evicting the women members and children from the rest of the two semi-pucca ghars and would deploy Anser contingent therein, petitioners at first, informed abut the order of injunction dated 03.03.2008'on 04.03.1008 to the then Anser Adjutant, Gazipur, Mr. Pobitra Kumar Shaha and thereafter, sent an application to him on the same date on 04.03.2008 With an order of injunction to his fax No. 9252124 (Annexure-C, C-3, C-4;) petitioner No. I Abdul Kalam, alias Kaliullah lodged G.D. entry No. 235 on 04.03.2008 (Annexure-CI) to the office of the then O.C. Gazipur, Mr. Md. Mizanur Rahman, opposite party no.9 informing, about granting of injunction, so that, they would not come again on 05.03.2008 for further eviction of the petitioners from 'Kha'(2) schedule suit property but without any result; the aforesaid facts of granting injunction by the High Court Division and from the 'Kha(2) schedule suit property on 03.03.2008 was published in the daily Newspaper "Prothom Alo" (Annexure-C2); the petitioners through their another Advocate Mr. Khandaker Quamrul Hassan (Ripon) also sent legal notice on 04.03.2008 upon the opposite party No. I to 7 demanding Tk. one (Tore as damage for demolishing their structures within 07 (seven) days and also requested them not to further evict: the petitioners from their rest two semi-pucca ghars by guaranteed express post. continental currier service and also to fax No. 9261899 of Deputy Commissioner, 

 Gazipur and fax No. 9252167 of S.P. Gazipur on 04.03.2008 at 1.47 P.M. that the order of injunction sent through the special Messenger were also served upon the opposite party No. 2, Madhab Bigraha and Manager, Court of Wards on 04.03.2008. 

 8. Inspite of their knowledge about order of injunction granted by the Hon'able High Court Division, opposite party No. 1, 4, 8 and 9 under the direction of opposite party Nos. 5, 6 and 7 respectively again came on 05.03.2008 at about 2 P.M. in the 'Kha(2)' schedule property for evicting female members and children from two rest of the semi pucca houses. Mrs. Toslima Momin Lima, Advocate, this time too rushed to 'Kha'(2)' schedule suit property with certified copy of order of injunction dated 03.03.2008 and by showing the said certified copy, requested opposite party No. 8 and 9 not to further demolish and evict the female members from the rest of the two houses of 'Kha(2)'schedule suit property but both of them by uttering again bad words started to evict the female members of the petitions and their tenants therefrom in front of the journalist, media men of Boishakhi Television and arrested two female members therefrom and started a false Criminal Case being No. 32(3)/2008 (Annexure-E) against them and other members of the petitioners under section 143, 447, 186, 332, 353, 307 and 379 of the Penal Code stating that they were making obstacle in taking over possession of Kha(2) schedule property. The said news of eviction violating the order of injunction was broadcasted on the next day on 06.03.2008 at its 4.45 news of Baishakhi Television. Thereafter, the opposite party No. 10, the then Anser adjutant, Mr. Probitra Kumar Shaha, deployed Anser on 05.03.2008 inspite of direct knowledge of injunction granted by the Hon'ble High Court Division and till today the Anser deployed by opposite party No. 10 are protecting the illegal possession of the Court of Wards taken on 03.03.2008 and 05.03.2008 by evicting the petitioners from 'Kha(2)' schedules property; opposite party Nos. 1 to 10 in collusion with each other having evicted from their 'Kha(2)'schedule properties on 03.03.2008 and 05.03.2008 violating the order of injunction granted by the Hon'ble High Court Division are liable to be punished for such violation and to pay compensation of Tk. 1.00,00,000/=(One crore) only as damages of demolishing petitioners' houses as demanded by the petitioners by serving legal notice dated 04.03.2008 from their own pocket. 

 9. A Division Bench of this Court issued Rule as: 

 "Let a rule issue calling upon opposite party .Nos. 1-10 to show cause as to why their personal properties shall not be attached for payment of compensation of damages caused to the petitioner by demolishing their houses in the `Kha' (2) schedule property and as to why they shall not be detained in civil prison for a period of six months for willful violation/disobedience of the order of injunction passed by this Court on 03.03.2008 in Civil Rule No. 132 (FM) of 2008 and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper." 

 1. Abdur Rouf, Manager, Bhwal Raj Court of Words Estate of 141-143 Motijheel Commercial Area, P.S. Motijheel, District-Dhaka. 2. Sree Sree Madhab represented by Manager Abdur Rouf Bhwal Raj Court of Wards Estate P.S. Joydebpur, District-Gazipur. 3. Court of Words; Bhwal Raj Estate, represented by its Manager Abdur Rouf of 141-143 Motijheel Commercial Area, P.S. Motijheel, District-Dhaka. 4. Md. Sabbir Hossain. Assistant Manager Bhawal Raj Court of Wards Estate P.S. Joydebpur, District-Gazipur. 5. Monirul Islam, Chairman Land Reforms Board of 141 -143 Motijheel Commercial Area, P.S. Motijheel, District -Dhaka. 6. Syed Mizanur Rahman, Deputy Commissioner Gazipur -District, District-Gazipur. 7. A lamgir Alam Superintendent of Police Gazipur-District, District-Gazipur. 8. Md. Shahjalal Assistant Commissioner/ Magistrate Gazipur,District, District-Gazipur. 9. Md. Mizanur Rahman Officer-in-charge Joydebpur Police Station Thana- Joydebpur, District-Gazipur. 10. Pabitra Kumar Shaha Anser Adjutant, Gazipur District-Gazipur. 

 11. Opposite party Nos. 1-10 jointly filed counter affidavit by swearing affidavit through opposite party No. 1 Mr. Abdur Roof, who claims himself as shebayet of the opposite party No.2, the deity Sree Sree Madhab Bigraha and Manager of the opposite party No.3, the Court of Wards, Bhawal Raj Estate and also Claimed as Tadbirkar of the other opposite party Nos.4 to 10 who are Government servants stating nothing about his relationship with them though the allegation of violation against each of the opposite parties are distinct and liability thereof are also distinct and several in a violation case. In the said affidavit he stated amongst other that he is conversant with the facts and circumstances with the case as made out in the petition under order 39 rule-(3) of the Code of Civil Procedure. He apart from denying the allegation of violation of injunction order stated amongst other that the present petitioners, Khaliullah and others were not owners of 'Kha(2)' schedule suit properties and also were not in possession thereof and as such, they were not necessary parties in the previous Title suit No. 1219 of 1985. Decree passed in Title Suit No. 1219 of 1985 is not a fraudulent decree. Petitioners falsely have initiated Title Suit No. 23 of 2008 and filed the application for temporary injunction upon false statements. He further stated that he did not influence the Deputy Commissioner, Gazipur for sending Executive Magistrate, opposite party No. 8 on 2 8.02.2008 for eviction of the petitioners and the news published in the local News papers about the incidents of 28.02.2008 and also the contents of the G.D. entry No. 142 dated 02.03.2008 are false. He further stated that the petitioners were being not in possession of 'Kha(2)' schedule suit property question of eviction on 03.03.2008 and 05.03.2008 does not arise at all. So, the opposite parties have not violated the injunction order in taking over possession of 'Kha.(2) schedule suit property. Opposite, party No. 9 and 10 having not been added as party in Title Suit No. 23 of 2008, they were not necessary parties in the present violation rule and have been impleaded only to harass them; the Court of Wards being a local authority requested opposite party No. 6. Deputy Commissioner, Gazipur for evicting the illegal occupants of 'Kha(2)' schedule suit properties under the provision of Government and Local Authority. Land and buildings Recovery Act, 1970. Accordingly, the Executive Magistrate, Mollika Khutun evicted the illegal occupiers from 'Kha(2)' schedule suit property on 03.03.2008 at 9 P.M. to 11.40 A.M. as per order of eviction issued by the respondent No. 6, Mr. Syed Mizanur Rahman, the then Deputy Commissioner of Gazipur, passed in Eviction Case No. 3 of 2006 started under Government and Local Authority (Land and building) Recovery Act, 1970 and now the Bhawal Raj Estate is in legal possession of the suit property; against the order of injunction passed in Civil Rule No. 132 (F.M)/ 2008 opposite party Nos. 1, 2 and 3 preferred Civil Miscellaneous Petition for leave to appeal No. 228 of 2008 before the Appellate Division of the Hon'ble Supreme Court for staying operation of the order of injunction dated 03.03.2008 and got an order of stay on 16.03.2008 and thereafter filed Civil Petition for Leave to appeal No. 680 of 2008 in which stay' order granted earlier has been extended till its disposal. 

 12. Against the counter affidavit filed by opposite party No. 1 to 10, the petitioner, Abul Kalam alias Khaliullah and others filed affidavit in reply stating amongst others that the story of eviction at 9.00 A.M. to 11.45 P.M with the help of Police force on 03.03.2008 are not correct and further stated that the deity being a private artificial person has got no authority to evict the petitioners from their homestead on 03.03.2008 in presence of Advocate. Mrs. Toslima Momin Lima and on 05.03.2008 in presence of said Advocate, Toslima Momin Lima and other 3 Advocates who also sworn affidavit on 10.06.2008 narrating the facts of eviction happened in their presence. They also stated that the facts of eviction of women members from the rest of the two room dated 05.03.2008 were taken place in their presence and the cameraman of Baishakhi Television had taken live pictures thereof and broadcasted in its next clays news on 06.03.2008 at 4.45 P.M. Advocate Mrs. Taslima Momin Lima sworn an affidavit on 04.06.2008 and learned Advocate, Mr. Khandaker Quamrul Hasan (Ripon), Advocates, Ataur Rahman and Sayed Md. Abu Fazal have jointly sworned another affidavit on 10.06.2008 narrating the facts of eviction held on 05.03.2008 in their presence stating that inspite of showing certified copy of the injunction order passed by this Court the opposite party Nos. 1 to 9 evicted the female members of the petitioners from `Kha'(2)1 schedule suit properties and thereafter arrested female member therefrom by starting Criminal Case against them. Opposite party Nos. 1 to 10 though denied the facts stated in the affidavits of aforesaid 4 learned Advocates, but had not made any positive statements against their statements of facts. 

 13. During the hearing of the Rule, the petitioners filed application for using the Paper Book of Appeal from Original Decree No. 128 of 2012 for considering oral and documentary evidences contained therein of P.W.S. and D.W.S. of Title Suit No.23 of 2008 before this Bench for proper and effectual adjudication of the present violation civil rule No.178(F.M) (Violation)/ 2008, which was allowed by this Court. 

 14. Upon considering the aforesaid facts stated in the violation petition, counter affidavit and affidavit in reply this court framed the following issues: 

 (1) Whether by dispossessing the plaintiffs opposite parties intentionally violated the order passed by this Court. 

 (ii) Whether, the opposite parties were aware of pendency of the proceeding before the Court. 

 (iv) Whether installing of ansars and continuing of possession of the ansars are continuous violation of Court's order. 

 (v) After in know of the order of this Court whether opposite parties are guilty of continuous violation of Court's order in not restoring possession of the plaintiffs. 

 15. Order XXXIX Rule 2 of sub Rule 3 of the Code of Civil Procedure dealt with disobedience of "In case of disobedience, or of a breach of any such terms, the Court granting an injunction may order the property of the person guilty of such disobedience or breach of the attached, and may also order such person to be detained in the civil prison for a term not exceeding six months, unless in the meantime the Court directs his release. 

 Violation of court's order is a serious offence and it should be dealt with severely unless violators could make out the case that they had no knowledge. Since individual case is to be dealt with as such individual act of the individual parties are to be considered. 

 (a) Wheather the opposite party No.1 Abdur Rouf as Manager of Court of Wards and Mr. Md. Sabbir Hossain, the opposite party No. 4 as Assistant Manager of Court of Wards, opposite party No. 5, Mr. Monirul Islam, the then Chairman of land Reform board and opposite party No.6, Mr. Sayed Mizanur Rahman, the then, Deputy Commissioner,  Gazipur had any authority in evicting the petitioners from their 'kha(2)' schedule suit property. 

 17. Mr. Nurul Amin, learned Advocate of the opposite party Nos. 1 to 10 at the very outset raised a question of maintainability of the violation rule submitting that the order of injunction dated 03.02.2008 was passed only against two legal persons namely, the opposite party No.2, deity. Madhap bigraha (who was defendant No. 1 in the Title No. 23 of 2008) and against opposite party No. 3, Court of Wards,(who was defendant No. 14 in Title Suit No.23 of 2008) and not against other persons. So, impleading other living persons, like opposite party no.1, Abdur Rouf, Manager of Bhawal Raj Estate. opposite party No. 4, Md. Sabbir Hossain, Assistant Manager, Bhawal Court of 'Wards, opposite party No.5. Mr. Monirul Islam, the then Chairman. Land Reform Board cannot be blamed and punished for working for and on behalf of the aforesaid two legal persons even if the alleged eviction is proved by violating the order of injunction dated 03.03.2008 Learned Advocate Mr. Nurul Amin further submitted that the other opposite parties Nos. 6 to 10 being not party in the Title Suit No. 23 of 2008, they also cannot be punished for violation of the order of injunction dated 03.03.2008, passed by the High Court Division. 

 18. On the other hand, Mr. Md. Khalilur Rahman, learned Advocate of the petitioners, submitted that, the order passed against some statutory organization, corporation for legal person is binding not only upon the said organization and legal person but also upon its officers, managers, who execute its works for and on behalf of said organization, corporation and legal person as per rule 5 of the order XXXIX of the Code of Civil Procedure. In this respect the petitioner's learned Advocate cited a ruling of the High Court Division reported in 1 i BLT 349 which is as follows: 

 "An injunction directed to company is binding not only on it but also on all its directors, share holders and officers and employees since a company functions through them. All of them are bound to obey the order of the Court, if it is within their notice and knowledge, no matter whether they are personally impleaded or not." 

 As to the liability of the persons for violating the order of injunction who are not party in the suit or against whom injunction had not been passed, learned Advocate, Md. Khalilur Rahman by citing ruling reported in 53 DLR (AD) 70, 28 DLR (AD) 165 submitted that a person who is aware of an order of injunction of a court is bound to obey it even if he is not a party to the suit. 

 21. For ascertaining the aforesaid first disputed question of fact as to possession of the petitioners in the `Kha(2)' schedule suit property it is enough for proving the same, if we go through deposition of DW-I, Mr. Sabbir Ahmed, Assistant Manager, Bhawal Court of Wards who is opposite party No. 4 in this violation rule. Opposite party No. 4 deposed as DW-1 for and on behalf of defendant No. 1, deity and defendant No. 14, the Court of Wards in title suit No. 23 of 2008 as follows: 

 23. Now, the second question, whether the opposite party No.1 to 10 had evicted the petitioners with the knowledge of the order of injunction as alleged by them. It is alleged by the opposite parties No. 1 to 10 that they had evicted the petitioners on 03.03.2008 in between 9.00 A.M. to 11.45 A.M before reaching the order of injunction to them. On the other hand, the plaintiff-petitioners stated that the injunction order was passed by the Division Bench of the Hon'ble High Court Division consisting of their Lordships Mr. Justice M.A Wahab Miah and Mr. Afzal' Hossain Ahmed, on 03.03.2008 at 11.45 A.M. and their learned Advocate Mr. Md. Khalilur Rahman, sent the said order of injunction to fax No. 9252751 to learned Advocate of Gazipur Bar, Mrs. Toslima Momin Lima at 1.30 P.M who after receiving the said fax rushed to 'kha(2)' schedule suit property within 10 minutes and was waiting for showing the same to the opposite parties who went to the suit property at 2.00 P.M. for eviction. Mrs Lima, Advocate, though showed the said order of injunction sent through fax but the opposite party No. 9, Mr. Mizanur Rahman, O.C. Gazipur and opposite party No. 8, Mr. Shahajalal Executive Magistrate, Gazipur, engaged in the eviction case started eviction of the petitioners and their tenants in `kha(2)'schedule suit property violating the order of injunction. The petitioners for proving the aforesaid facts, knowledge of injunction of the opposite parties, annexed several documentary evidences as annexures with the violation petition. From annexure-C it reveals the order of injunction was sent by fax to the fax of the Deputy Commissioner, Gazipur, bearing No. 9261899 on 04.03.2008 and it reveals from annexure-C (1) that the opposite party No. 9, 0.C,. Jaydebpur, was informed about the order of injunction vide G.D No.235 dated 04.03.2008 and the S.P, Gazipur was informed to his fax No.9252167 on 04.03.2008 Moreover, the order of injunction was also served by special messenger on 04.03.2008 upon the opposite party No.2 and 3. The opposite party No. 1 to 10 in their affidavit though vaguely denied of receiving such fax but did not deny that they had no such fax No. 9261899 and 9252167. Since, both the office of S.P and D.C being public office there is no reason of non receiving such fax. Apart from sending the aforesaid fax the news of eviction both on 03.03.2008 and 05.03.2008 published both in local and National News Paper about violating the order of injunction dated 03.03.2008 have neither been denied nor challenged by publishing objection letter. As to the deployment of Ansar by the opposite party No. 10 violating the order of injunction the petitioners specifically stated that they informed about the order of injunction by sending fax to his fax No. 9252129 on 04.03.2008 Annexure C(4) and thereafter on the same date filed an application attaching order of injunction therewith So, it can easily be presumed that the respondent No. 10 had knowledge about the order of injunction. Apart from the aforesaid documentary evidences, the petitioners also proved about the knowledge of order of injunction and its violation by citing 7 witnesses. Out of the aforesaid witnesses, the statements made by Advocate Lima, P.W-4 is very much important. The said witnesses stated in her deposition as follows: 

 25. On the other hand, P.W.-2, Akkas Ali, is a contiguous neighbor of 'kha(2)' schedule suit property and a man of 70 years old. He deposed that the rest 2 tin shed ghars remained after eviction of `kha(2)' schedule suit property is being used by Ansar contingent deployed by the opposite party No. 10. He further stated that on 03.03.2008 he was coming back from Rice Research Institute to his house and found that the police contingent are taking preparation to enter in to the house of Abul Kalam @,Kaliullah and others. One women lawyer was prohibiting the police from entering into the houses of Abul Kalam @kaliullah but the police contingent entered into kaliullah's house violating her request and started to demolish the houses leaving only 2-4 ghars. He further stated that on 05.03.2008 they came again with the help of combined force and put the wife of Abu] Kalam and other women in a police van from the remaining, ghars inspite of protest raised by 3 lawyers showing order of injunction of High Court Division. He further stated that except the evicted `kha(2)' .schedule suit property other 5 pieces `kha' schedule properties are yet in position of the plaintiffs, Abul Kalam and others. The said witness was cross examined but no contradictions have been achieved by the contesting defendants. 

 28. P. W-6, Mr. Mahbub. Advocate. is a survey knowing Advocate commissioner. He proved his report and exhibited the same as x series.  38. As long as injunction continuous, the defendant against whom it is issued can not disobey it. The only remedy open to him is to go either to the court which passed the order or to the superior court and get the order vacated. If the injunction is disobeyed during its continuance, the defendant holds himself liable for punishable under the law. Violation of Court's order is a sin and no body should violate the order of the Court after knowing it. Thus, a person against whom an injunction order is operative can not disobey it on the strength of any law or any executive order. Although there might be a breach of an injunction in the literal sense, yet if the party acted in good faith and without any intention to violate the order he will not be liable for punishment. So long the order stands and its order has not been suspended, it will not be tolerated that any person should disobey the order. The jurisdiction conferred for punishing a contumacious party is to vindicate the supremacy of rule of law and not to benefit parties. In punishing a violator court is not concerned with legal effect of order. Test is whether the order has been disregarded. If a party takes possession in breach of an injunction order court has power to restore possession. Violator unless proved the order was ambiguous and reasonably capable of more than one interpretation or act in good faith without any intention of disobey the order can not escape punishment.
